reason: Our current system works well enough and the vendor knows us; I'm not going to ask a volunteer board to run a pilot with two founders nobody has heard of while our members are mostly over 60. The free pilot is nice, but our time and goodwill aren't free.
objection: Our older members will not install and use a new app, and if half of them get stuck it's me and the other volunteers who get the phone calls, not some helpline for four weeks.
would_change_my_mind: Calling the board of Golfclub Zwolle after a year live and hearing that their older members actually use it and the switch didn't land on the volunteers.
